sentences.fa: خبر رو شنيدي؟
sentences.en: have you heard the news?

sentences.fa: خبر رو ديشب شنيدي؟
sentences.en: Did you hear the news last night?

sentences.fa: خبر رو در مورد استعفاي من شنيدي؟
sentences.en: Have you heard the news about my resignation?

sentences.fa: ديشب بعد از فوتبال خبر رو شنيدي؟
sentences.en: Did you hear the news after the football match last night?

sentences.fa: خبر رو ديشب از شبکه يک شنيدي؟
sentences.en: Did you hear the news on channel one last night?

sentences.fa: نه، چي شده؟
sentences.en: No, what is it?

sentences.fa: اونها مي خوان پارک اونور خيابون رو به پارکينگ ماشين تبديل کنند.
sentences.en: They are gonna make the park across the street into a car park.

sentences.fa: بيا بريم اونور خيابون.
sentences.en: Let's cross the street.

sentences.fa: بيا بريم اونور رودخونه.
sentences.en: Let's cross the river.

sentences.fa: برادرم از شغلش خسته هست، مي خواد سوپر مارکتش رو به قنادي تبديل کنه.
sentences.en: My brother is tired of his job, he is gonna make his supermarket into confectionary.

sentences.fa: شغلم رونق نداره، مي خوام قناديم رو به قصابي تبديل کنم.
sentences.en: My job is really sick, I am gonna make my confectionary into the butcher's.

sentences.fa: شوهرم مغازش رو فروخته، مي خواد مغازش رو به گيم نت تبديل کنه.
sentences.en: My husband has sold his shop, he is gonna make his shop into the game net.

sentences.fa: مغازه ام رو مي خوام به فروشگاه بزرگ تبديل کنم.
sentences.en: I am gonna make my shop into the big store.

sentences.fa: خبر خوبي بهت بدم؟
sentences.en: Shall I give you good news?

sentences.fa: دولت مي خواد باغ هاي حومه شهر رو به استاديوم تبديل کنه.
sentences.en: The government is gonna make the gardens in the suburb into the stadium.

sentences.fa: شهرداري مي خواد پارک خيابون بالايي رو به زمين تنيس تبديل کنه.
sentences.en: City hall is gonna make the park in the high street into the tennis court.

sentences.fa: مي خوام اينجا رو به سالن زيبايي تبديل کنم.
sentences.en: I am gonna make here into the beauty salon.

sentences.fa: بازار راکده، مي خوام طلا فروشيم رو به سوپرمارکت تبديل کنم.
sentences.en: The market is dull, I am gonna make my jewelry into the super market.

sentences.fa: قاضي حکم پدرم رو صادر کرد.
sentences.en: The judge handed down my father's verdict.

sentences.fa: حکم پدرم صادر شد.
sentences.en: My father's verdict was handed down.

sentences.fa: پدرم به چهار سال زندان محکوم شد.
sentences.en: My father was sentenced to 4 years imprisonment.

sentences.fa: پدرم به حبس ابد محکوم شد.
sentences.en: My father has been sentenced to life imprisonment.

sentences.fa: يه نفر به برادرم زنگ زد، به مرگ تهديدش کرد.
sentences.en: Somebody called my brother; he has been threatened to death.

sentences.fa: به من اتهام آدم کشي زده شده.
sentences.en: I have been accused of homicide.

sentences.fa: ينفر بمن اتهام آدم کشي زده.
sentences.en: Somebody has accused me of a homicide.

sentences.fa: افغانستان توسط ارتش آمريکا تسخير شد.
sentences.en: Afghanistan was concurred by US army.

sentences.fa: زلزله رخ داده.
sentences.en: There has been an earth quick.

sentences.fa: توفان رخ داده.
sentences.en: There has been a storm.

sentences.fa: باورش نمي کنم.
sentences.en: I don't believe it.

sentences.fa: باورش مي کني؟
sentences.en: Do you believe it?

sentences.fa: باورش نکن.
sentences.en: Don't believe it.

sentences.fa: باور نمي کنم يه دروغه.
sentences.en: I don't believe it, it's a lie.

sentences.fa: باور نمي کنم، دروغ شاخداره.
sentences.en: I don't believe it, it's a blatant lie.

sentences.fa: يه دروغ شاخداره. (آمريکايي)
sentences.en: It's a big lie.

sentences.fa: باور نکن، يه دروغ مصلحتي هست.
sentences.en: Don't believe it, it was a white lie.

sentences.fa: جلسه فردا کنسل شده.
sentences.en: Tomorrow's meeting has been canceled.

conversation: A: Have you heard the news?
A: They are gonna make the park across the street into a car park.
B: They are gonna make the park across the street into the car park?! I don't believe it. Where did you hear that?
A: All the neighbors talking about that.
B: Do you think it's true?
A: I think so, but I don't know for sure. I doubt it.
